name: web-ui-playbook
description: Self-contained UI/UX playbook skill: professional websites, landing pages, dashboards and forms for non-designers. Tuned for Laravel + Tailwind CSS v4 and Persian/RTL interfaces for users inside Iran (Vazirmatn, Persian digits, ZWNJ, Jalali, Toman, SMS-OTP, Shaparak/eNamad, no foreign CDNs). Asks intake questions, picks a style and real reference sites, sets design tokens first, builds, then audits and fixes its own output.
